title: Expire input
description: The service's expiry task removes one message whose `expires` has passed. `now` is the Clock port's reading. A decision that names a `default_on_silence` is answered by silence instead and kept until `keep_until`.

keep_until.description: Until when an answer taken on silence waits for the sender; the service sends `now` plus its answer retention.

inbox.messaging.MessageId.title: MessageId
inbox.messaging.MessageId.description: A ULID the sender sets. A sender that posts a message again sends the same id.
